evals.name: lab-style-dashboard
evals.prompt: I'm building an internal admin dashboard for a Memgraph deployment. It has a query editor panel on the left and a results table on the right. Can you generate the HTML and CSS for it so it looks like it belongs in the Memgraph product family?
evals.expected_output: A dashboard that follows the Memgraph brand system: neutral white/gray surfaces where orange is only a small accent on the primary action, Inter Tight for UI text and Ubuntu Mono for the query/code area, 4px-grid spacing, border radii limited to {2px, 4px, 8px, 999px}, and no gradient backgrounds or glow/drop-shadow-on-everything.
assertions: The UI text uses the Inter Tight font family, and the query editor / code / monospace area uses Ubuntu Mono; no other typefaces are introduced.
Panel, card, and canvas surface backgrounds are white (#FFFFFF) or canvas gray (#F9F9F9), and orange #FB6E00 is not used as a large surface fill or as a border/divider color.
Orange #FB6E00 appears only as a sparing accent (e.g. primary button or active state) while neutral whites and grays dominate the layout — orange is not the dominant color.
Every border-radius value is one of 2px, 4px, 8px, or 999px — there are no 12px, 16px, or 24px radii.
There are no gradient backgrounds and no glow/inner-shadow effects, and shadows are not applied to every element.

evals.name: cta-button-voice
evals.prompt: Write the markup and copy for the primary call-to-action button plus its heading on a Memgraph feature splash page that nudges users to try running a graph query.
evals.expected_output: A CTA in Memgraph's voice: an imperative, second-person, sentence-case button label such as "Run query" with no exclamation marks, emoji, or marketing hype; the primary button filled with orange #FB6E00; heading text in brand black #231F20 using Inter Tight; and a small allowed corner radius rather than a decorative rounded pill.
assertions: The button label is imperative and second-person in sentence case (e.g. "Run query" or "Connect to instance"), not Title Case or ALL CAPS.
The copy contains no exclamation marks, no emoji, and no marketing or hype language.
The primary button is filled with orange #FB6E00.
Body/heading text uses brand black #231F20 (not pure #000000) and the Inter Tight font.
The button is not styled as a decorative rounded pill; its corners use a small allowed radius (2px, 4px, or 8px).

evals.name: mermaid-architecture-diagram
evals.prompt: Give me a Mermaid diagram of a Memgraph streaming architecture (a Kafka source feeding into Memgraph, then out to a downstream app), styled to match Memgraph's brand.
evals.expected_output: A Mermaid diagram themed with the Memgraph palette: brand black #231F20 text, neutral gray/white node fills, orange #FB6E00 only as a sparing accent on at most one focal node, semantic colors used only when meaningful, no emoji in labels, and restrained (no glow, no icon soup, no invented colors or gradients).
assertions: Node and edge label text uses brand black #231F20 (not pure black), and no label contains emoji.
Node fills are neutral (white or a palette gray such as #F9F9F9), with orange #FB6E00 used only as a sparing accent on at most one focal node rather than as the fill for most nodes.

Every color used comes from the defined brand tokens (brand black #231F20, orange #FB6E00, the grays, or the semantic colors success #19AF66 / error #DC2223 / warning #FFC500) — no invented/arbitrary colors and no gradient fills.
The diagram avoids decorative excess consistent with "restraint over decoration" — no glow or drop-shadow effects on nodes and no icon soup.
